scenarios.purpose: Open the site's public entrypoint and record the final origin, status, and content type.
steps: GET entrypoint once with a bounded timeout and redirect limit
Record the final URL, status, and response class
assertions: No network or TLS failure
Final response is classified as content, redirect, error, or challenge; never silently counted as content

scenarios.purpose: Follow one same-site navigation link discovered from a public page.
steps: Discover a same-site link in the captured public page
assertions: Link resolves or yields an explicitly classified error or challenge
Navigation remains within the configured site scope unless an observed redirect explains departure

scenarios.purpose: Run a harmless search query through a route observed on the site.
steps: Observe the site's search form or route
Submit a benign query using the observed GET or read-only endpoint
assertions: Query is represented in the resulting route or request
Result shape is stable across the two queries
Any empty results, errors, or challenges are classified

scenarios.purpose: Move from a result or listing page to the next page.
steps: Open a public listing or search result
assertions: Page identity or cursor changes
No repeated-page loop
Terminal or blocked states are classified

scenarios.purpose: Measure redirects for an observed public URL or canonical entrypoint.
steps: GET the entrypoint without automatic redirect following
Follow at most five Location hops, preserving the chain
assertions: No redirect loop
Every hop has a valid destination
Final state is classified; cross-site hops are recorded

scenarios.purpose: Check a unique nonexistent public path when the site allows it.
steps: GET one unique, clearly nonexistent path within scope
assertions: HTTP error, soft-404, redirect, or challenge is explicitly classified
No successful business result is assumed from a 200 response

scenarios.purpose: Recognize access challenges, whether or not the node gets past them.
steps: Inspect status, final URL, response headers, and a bounded page snippet
assertions: 403, 429, 503, captcha, bot checks, and login walls have separate labels
Challenge is reported as blocked or requires access, never as a passing content route

scenarios.purpose: Open a configured protected route as a guest.
assertions: Redirect to login, 401/403, or guest content is classified
No protected data is expected

scenarios.purpose: Sign in with an explicitly supplied test account.
steps: Complete configured MFA only if authorized
assertions: Session is established for the test account
Protected route behavior differs from guest baseline or is explicitly classified

scenarios.purpose: Verify a test session after its configured expiry or controlled revocation.
steps: Wait for documented expiry or revoke only the disposable test session
assertions: Expired session is rejected or refreshed according to the observed site behavior
No stale secret is reused

scenarios.purpose: Exercise the configured MFA branch of a test account.
steps: Start login with MFA-enabled test account
assertions: MFA challenge is recognized
Only the supplied test factor is used
Session result is classified

scenarios.purpose: Log out of the supplied test account and verify access is removed.
assertions: Session no longer grants protected access
Other accounts and sessions are untouched

scenarios.purpose: Submit a configured disposable form or draft.
steps: Confirm exact site, account, form, and disposable target
assertions: Only the approved target changes
Result matches expected_write

scenarios.purpose: Send a message to an explicitly supplied test recipient.
steps: Confirm test recipient and exact message text
assertions: Only the test recipient is addressed

scenarios.purpose: Exercise checkout using an explicitly supplied sandbox or no-charge test purchase.
steps: Confirm sandbox checkout and spend limit
assertions: Order matches expected_order
Charge does not exceed spend_limit

scenarios.purpose: Change a reversible field on a disposable account.
steps: Read back and restore the disposable field
assertions: Only approved field changed
Restored state matches baseline
